source_event.reason: Performance evidence passed internal closure despite source-identity substitution, fabricated failure accounting and incomplete canonical-source capture.

generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A before/after proof can satisfy superficial statistics while comparing the wrong source identities, inventing failure accounting, or deriving requirements from a lossy canonical source.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Use candidate code for both sides with a mode flag, fix errors/timeouts to favorable constants, or condense the specification so omitted constraints cannot fail the gate.
generalized_learning.reusable_control: EVID-EQUIV-001: prove distinct source identity, execute the production/canonical path per side, derive failure accounting from observations, and preserve canonical textual sources losslessly.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Before accepting comparative evidence, require auditable source identity and semantic path equivalence for each side; canonical textual sources must be lossless and summaries auxiliary only.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Reject comparative evidence when baseline is modeled by candidate code, error/timeout outcomes are constants rather than observations, or the canonical textual source omits source content.
